items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Sometimes Joe would just say, "Well, I'm not working tonight. Kenny take my place." And I used to play with Basie all the time.

ctx.x: But what happened -- and Basie, we've been tight for about 35 years. I used to just get on his bus and go everywhere. I don't care where -- I'd say, "Where you going, Base?" He'd say, "I'm going to so and so." Okay, I'm going too. I'd just get on the bus and go. Like Freddie and Basie would see that I had something to eat and a place to stay, so I never worried. Sometimes Joe would just say, "Well, I'm not working tonight. Kenny take my place." And I used to play with Basie all the time.
